problem.title: Minimum Cost to Hire K Workers
problem.problemStatement: Given the quality and minimum wage expectation of each worker, determine the minimum total cost required to hire exactly K workers while satisfying each worker's wage expectation.
problem.input: • First line contains integers N and K. • Second line contains N integers representing quality. • Third line contains N integers representing minimum wages.
